smallest_conditional_future_scope.description: A hypothesis-local, snapshot-specific check of the book's percentage-based sufficient condition only, using exact already-authorized comparable percentage operands or an explicitly approved endpoint-to-percentage contract. Establishing sufficiency would review P005's supplied scope only; all other cases remain unresolved in this narrow design. No negative invalidator or certificate producer is proposed.
smallest_conditional_future_scope.formula_documentation_only: IF R3 > R1 OR R3 > R5, the book's sufficient condition is established; OTHERWISE no result follows from this implication alone.
safety_limits: No authority from arbitrary caller numbers.
